decisions.reason: As a large German door-system maker, the firm is likely to keep this core industrial sectional door because it fits its stated strategy, uses established manufacturing and compliance capabilities, and prior launch investments make management reluctant to withdraw it absent clear failure evidence.

This insulated glazed industrial door is close to the firm's mainstream commercial offering and customer needs, so sunk development and marketing effort plus its strategic fit with flexible, regulation-ready solutions make continuation more likely than withdrawal.

Because this product received especially visible website commitment through its own page and belongs to the firm's central industrial door range, escalation of commitment and product-line coherence both point to keeping it on the market.
